---
title: "Teaching"
---

I teach undergraduate and postgraduate courses in communications, embedded systems, electronics, mathematics, and signal processing.

## Current and recent courses

| Area | Courses |
|---|---|
| Communications | Satellite Communication Systems · Optical Communications · Mobile Communication Systems · Data Communication and Computer Networks |
| Embedded systems | Introduction to Embedded Systems · Micro-controller and Embedded Systems · Industrial Networks |
| Foundations | Logic Design · Electronics · Electronic Circuits and Measurements · Electrical Communications |
| Mathematics | Numerical Analysis · Complex & Special Functions and Numerical Analysis · Mathematics II |
| Postgraduate | Adaptive Signal Processing · Optical Fiber Networks · Selected Topics in Wireless Communications |

## Supervision

I have supervised 5 MSc students, 1 PhD student, and 5 undergraduate graduation projects affiliated with the Department of Electronics and Electrical Communications Engineering, Faculty of Engineering, Tanta University.
